motion.name: focus-ease
motion.purpose: default ease-out for controls and transitions

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary CTA for login, register and major actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.17 257); color: oklch(0.99 0.01 262); border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 12px 20px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Surface card
components.description: Neutral container for feature and settings surfaces.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }

narrative.overview: NovaChat focuses on flow-first conversation and fast task completion.

rules.name: Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary should stay under 25% visual occupancy per full page.

rules.name: Readable Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Spacing and weight carry hierarchy before color does.

dos: Use visible focus states for all interactive elements.
Use established spacing scale instead of random values.
Keep surfaces compact and avoid oversizing cards.
donts: Do not repeat identical card grids across every section.
Do not use decorative gradients for non-decorative contexts.
Do not add shadows to static neutral containers.
